Living Monolith.fact: Later, Abdol abducts Mister Fantastic, the Invisible Woman, and the Human Torch to absorb cosmic radiation from their bodies, growing to a massive size.

Living Monolith.subject: International Relations
Living Monolith.question: Thor throws Abdol into outer space, where he becomes a "_____," similar to Ego
Living Monolith.fact: Thor throws Abdol into outer space, where he becomes a "Living Planet," similar to Ego.

Living Monolith.subject: International Relations
Living Monolith.question: It is later revealed that Abdol's formerly dormant mutant powers were activated by a procedure performed on him by _____
Living Monolith.fact: It is later revealed that Abdol's formerly dormant mutant powers were activated by a procedure performed on him by Mister Sinister.

Living Monolith.subject: International Relations
Living Monolith.question: Sinister spliced genes from _____ into his genome, thus giving Abdol the ability to absorb cosmic energy
Living Monolith.fact: Sinister spliced genes from Alex Summers into his genome, thus giving Abdol the ability to absorb cosmic energy.

Living Monolith.subject: International Relations
Living Monolith.question: Since his powers were modified to become genetically similar to _____'s, this explained why their abilities symbiotically interfered with one another's
Living Monolith.fact: Since his powers were modified to become genetically similar to Havok's, this explained why their abilities symbiotically interfered with one another's.

Living Monolith.subject: International Relations
Living Monolith.question: Abdol is found by Bishop and _____ floating in space
Living Monolith.fact: Abdol is found by Bishop and Deathbird floating in space. Deathbird betrays Bishop and brings Abdol to Apocalypse, who uses his body as an energy container during The Twelve story arc.

Living Monolith.subject: International Relations
Living Monolith.question: Deathbird betrays _____ and brings Abdol to Apocalypse, who uses his body as an energy container during The Twelve story arc
Living Monolith.fact: Abdol is found by Bishop and Deathbird floating in space. Deathbird betrays Bishop and brings Abdol to Apocalypse, who uses his body as an energy container during The Twelve story arc.

Living Monolith.subject: International Relations
Living Monolith.question: When the _____ of Cyttorak reappears on Earth and sends out a call to individuals suitable to become a new Juggernaut, Abdol hears the call and makes his way to the Temple of Cyttorak
Living Monolith.fact: When the Crimson Gem of Cyttorak reappears on Earth and sends out a call to individuals suitable to become a new Juggernaut, Abdol hears the call and makes his way to the Temple of Cyttorak.

Living Monolith.subject: International Relations
Living Monolith.question: Amidst conflict between demonic guardians of the Gem, the X-Men, and several prospective and former candidates for the _____'s power, Abdol manages to claim the Gem
Living Monolith.fact: When the Crimson Gem of Cyttorak reappears on Earth and sends out a call to individuals suitable to become a new Juggernaut, Abdol hears the call and makes his way to the Temple of Cyttorak. Amidst conflict between demonic guardians of the Gem, the X-Men, and several prospective and former candidates for the Juggernaut's power, Abdol manages to claim the Gem.

Living Monolith.subject: International Relations
Living Monolith.question: He loses his powers when _____ returns his power to his former host, Cain Marko
Living Monolith.fact: When the Crimson Gem of Cyttorak reappears on Earth and sends out a call to individuals suitable to become a new Juggernaut, Abdol hears the call and makes his way to the Temple of Cyttorak. He loses his powers when Cyttorak returns his power to his former host, Cain Marko.
